generator: crates/chat-turn/tests/record_entries.cjs (noevia-core chat-interrupted-turn.cjs createTurnRecord, chat-partial.cjs bounded and finish)

cases.name: no_events
cases.about: Nothing streamed: the Stopped placeholder.

cases.name: plain_answer
cases.about: A routed answer with sources and usage.

cases.name: unknown_and_non_object_events
cases.about: Unknown types, a non-string type and non-objects are ignored.

cases.name: non_string_texts
cases.about: str(): every non-string text is empty.

cases.name: leading_space_trim_start
cases.about: content.trimStart() with JS whitespace (U+FEFF, U+3000, U+2028); trailing space kept.

cases.name: nel_is_not_js_space
cases.about: U+0085 is not JS whitespace: the content is kept.

cases.name: zero_width_space_kept
cases.about: U+200B and U+180E are not whitespace either.

cases.name: whitespace_only_content
cases.about: Content that trims to nothing: the placeholder.

cases.name: preamble_removes_last_occurrence
cases.about: lastIndexOf: the later copy of the narration leaves the content.

events.text: QA check. Then QA check. Done.

cases.name: preamble_without_match
cases.about: Narration not in the content: content stays, thinking gets it trimmed.

cases.name: preamble_astral
cases.about: An astral narration inside astral content.

cases.name: preamble_whitespace_only
cases.about: A blank narration: trimmed to nothing, the separator still goes in when the field has text.

cases.name: preamble_blank_first
cases.about: A blank narration first adds nothing, not even a separator later.

cases.name: narration_kept_after_tools
cases.about: Cut off after tool steps before any answer: the narration is the text.

cases.name: stopped_keeps_reasoning_in_partial
cases.about: Only thinking: the assistant entry drops it, the partial entry keeps it raw.

cases.name: stopped_blank_reasoning
cases.about: Only blank thinking: no partial entry.

cases.name: stopped_with_running_tool
cases.about: A running call is stopped; the placeholder keeps the calls.

cases.name: stopped_pending_approval
cases.about: A pending approval card is stopped, target and kind kept.

cases.name: failed_without_writes
cases.about: A failed reply with no applied write is not kept.

cases.name: failed_with_writes
cases.about: A failed reply keeps the record of its writes; declined calls left out.

cases.name: failed_with_declined_pause
cases.about: A failed reply after a declined pause keeps that pause.

cases.name: failed_only_denied_applied
cases.about: The only applied call was declined: kept, with an empty call list.

cases.name: applied_writes_note
cases.about: Applied writes with no pause: the stopped note counts them.

cases.name: applied_only_no_text
cases.about: Applied writes and no text: the note keeps the entry.

cases.name: pause_declined_list
cases.about: The declined names: strings matching the tool name shape, deduplicated, at most 8.

cases.name: pause_declined_not_array
cases.about: A declined list that is not an array is empty.

cases.name: pause_sensitive
cases.about: sensitive-tool-result becomes sensitive.

cases.name: pause_supervision_default
cases.about: Any other reason is supervision; the last pause wins.

cases.name: pause_no_reason
cases.about: A pause with no reason.

cases.name: pause_applied_kinds
cases.about: applied: only a non-negative integer is kept.

cases.name: pause_applied_float_integer
cases.about: applied 2.0 is the integer 2.

cases.name: routing_detail_valid
cases.about: check-unavailable keeps a valid detail code.

cases.name: routing_detail_too_long
cases.about: A 41-unit detail is dropped.

cases.name: routing_detail_bad_shapes
cases.about: Uppercase, a digit first, a newline at the end, a number: dropped; the last meta wins.

cases.name: routing_detail_other_reason
cases.about: A detail with another reason is not kept.

cases.name: routing_rejected
cases.about: A route other than local/cloud, a non-string reason, a non-object routing: no target.

cases.name: route_kinds
cases.about: The route label is String(route).

cases.name: route_number
cases.about: A number route.

cases.name: route_falsy
cases.about: Falsy routes change nothing; a later meta without routingDecision clears it.

cases.name: route_object
cases.about: An object route is [object Object].

cases.name: route_throws
cases.about: A route with its own toString: observe throws, nothing of that meta is kept.

cases.name: stopped_route_target_kept
cases.about: The placeholder keeps routeTarget and stats, not routingDecision, reasoning or sources.

cases.name: sources_kinds
cases.about: Only an array replaces the sources; an empty one is left out.

cases.name: sources_kept
cases.about: A non-array after an array keeps the array.

cases.name: usage_counts
cases.about: count(): numbers only; elapsedMs from the clock at the usage event.

cases.name: usage_clock_backwards
cases.about: A clock that went back: elapsedMs is 0.

cases.name: usage_empty
cases.about: A usage with no counts keeps elapsedMs alone.

cases.name: tool_holes
cases.about: Indexes leave holes; filter(Boolean) skips them.

cases.name: tool_bad_indexes
cases.about: Negative, fractional, string and null indexes: appended.

cases.name: tool_properties_past_array
cases.about: Indexes 2^32 and 1e300 are properties, not elements: not kept.

cases.name: pending_without_index
cases.about: tool_pending without an index takes the last slot (or 0).

cases.name: pending_target_kinds
cases.about: target only when a non-empty string; targetKind only drive or drive-new.

cases.name: result_by_name
cases.about: A result without an index finds the first call of its name; none: appended.

cases.name: result_without_name
cases.about: A result with no name keeps the previous name, args, target and kind.

cases.name: result_target_override
cases.about: A result target replaces the card target; the kind stays.

cases.name: result_before_call
cases.about: A result for a call never announced.

cases.name: result_flags
cases.about: declined wins over notRun; only true counts.

cases.name: result_cap_exact
cases.about: A result of exactly 4000 units, and 4001.

cases.name: result_cap_pair_fits
cases.about: An astral character ending at unit 4000 is kept whole.

cases.name: result_cap_splits_pair
cases.about: The cut at 4000 falls inside a pair (Node keeps the lone high surrogate).

cases.name: result_cap_astral_only
cases.about: Astral-only text cut at 4000 units: 2000 characters.

cases.name: content_at_cap
cases.about: Content of exactly 65536 units: not truncated.

cases.name: content_over_cap
cases.about: Content of 65537 units: the newest 65536, truncated.

cases.name: content_cap_splits_pair
cases.about: The newest 65536 units start inside a pair (Node keeps the lone low surrogate).

cases.name: content_cap_pair_boundary
cases.about: The cut falls between two pairs.

cases.name: reasoning_over_cap
cases.about: Reasoning is cut too, but never marks truncated.

cases.name: stopped_reasoning_over_cap
cases.about: The placeholder keeps long thinking in the partial; it is cut.

cases.name: saved_at_now
cases.about: savedAt is Date.now() when the file is written.
